ops.statement: The harness was given the same fail-safe discipline as the production code under test: per-iteration work was wrapped in try/except with a guaranteed stop-signal in `finally`, and helper threads were marked daemon=True as a backstop.
ops.history: issue #460 gate g2 -- restated from imperative instruction to observation; grounded in a4 ("7 green re-runs followed the fix") and a3, which names exactly the two defects this fix addresses (a writer thread dying without signalling stop, and a non-daemon reader thread spinning forever)
